in_marathi.name: Mallikarjuna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mallikarjuna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mallikarjuna is a name of Lord Shiva. The name 'Mallikarjuna' can be divided into two parts. 'Mallika' means 'Goddess Parvathi' and 'Arjuna' means 'The Unconquerable'. So, Mallikarjuna refers to Lord Shiva, who is the unconquerable form of Lord Shiva with Goddess Parvathi.
